entries.note: rule-based; compartment holding pronator_teres, flexor_carpi_radialis, flexor_pollicis_longus (104.7 cm3), not split: PT/FPL split followed a pale line at 63 % of 27 shared levels and FCR/FPL at 66 % of 35; PT's region (7 cm3) is far too small for the muscle and FCR's (70 cm3) far too large, i.e. the line between them is not the PT/FCR/FPL septum. Kept together (105 cm3).

rule-based: position-rule marker in the radius-ulna frame, boundary by the marker watershed on his fascial septa; 57.0 cm3. REVIEW: 57 cm3 is several times a pronator quadratus; at f > 0.9 only its rule is active, so the whole distal muscle section (FDP/FDS/FPL bellies included) falls to it. NOT SHIPPED (main session 2026-09-14): volume more than twice the adult expectation, 57 cm3 against 8-12 expected (its rule takes the whole distal section); a rule artefact of the position lines, kept in the label volume for review, not shown under this name.

rule-based; compartment holding brachioradialis, extensor_carpi_radialis_longus, extensor_carpi_radialis_brevis (264.0 cm3), not split: BR/ECRL on a pale line at 68 % of 65 shared levels, ECRL/ECRB at 68 % of 62: the weakest extensor boundaries. The BR region (163 cm3) also holds the brachialis and biceps at the elbow levels (the position rules have no marker for them), so the compartment (264 cm3) is the anterolateral mass, not the three muscles alone.

rule-based; compartment holding extensor_digitorum, supinator, anconeus (48.6 cm3), not split: Anconeus/supinator on a pale line at only 44 % of 16 shared levels and ED/anconeus at 44 % of 9; the anconeus region (1.9 cm3) is too small to be the muscle, so ED, whose other boundaries hold (72-100 %), is kept with the two proximal muscles (49 cm3) rather than shipped with a border that does not run on a septum.
